_compute_has_department_manager_access resolves self.env.user (both to match
the reader against hr.department.manager_id and to compare against
employee_id.user_id) and declared no depends_context, so its cache held ONE
entry per record for the whole transaction and the first reader's answer was
handed to every reader after it.

The field is read from three ir.rule domain_force clauses (hr_holidays,
hr_timesheet, hr_skills), but those go through _search_has_department_manager_access,
not the compute -- the compute is what a view reads. Closed as part of the round-3
hr audit, which found ten computes in the module with no declared dependency at
all; this is the one of them the gate was already counting.
